about: Offline install advice per tool and OS family. `{v}` is replaced by the recommended version (or its major), `{major}` by the major version. Version managers already on the machine are suggested first (see versionManagers). Entries were written from the projects' official install pages; `check` marks advice that varies by distribution release.

debian: The distribution's nodejs package is often older than projects need; prefer a version manager (fnm, nvm, mise) or the NodeSource packages for Node.js {major}.
fedora: sudo dnf install nodejs  (check the version: dnf module list nodejs)
arch: sudo pacman -S nodejs npm  (always the current release; use nodejs-lts-* packages or a version manager for an older line)
windows: or a version manager: fnm (winget install Schniz.fnm) or nvm-windows
linux: Use a version manager (fnm, nvm or mise) to install Node.js {major}.

debian: sudo apt install npm  (Debian and Ubuntu package npm separately from nodejs)
macos: npm comes with Node.js: brew install node
windows: npm comes with Node.js: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS
linux: npm comes with Node.js from nodejs.org and version managers.

any: corepack enable pnpm  (Corepack ships with Node.js up to 24; on Node.js 25+ first run: npm install -g corepack)
corepack enable yarn  (uses the version in package.json's packageManager field; on Node.js 25+ first run: npm install -g corepack)

windows: powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1 | iex"  (official installer; downloads from bun.sh)
linux: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash  (official installer; read it first)
arch: Bun is in the AUR (bun-bin), or use the official installer.

debian: sudo apt install php-cli  (Ubuntu 24.04 ships PHP 8.3, Debian 12 ships 8.2; for other versions add the ondrej/php PPA on Ubuntu or packages.sury.org on Debian, then install php{v}-cli)
fedora: sudo dnf install php-cli  (for other versions: the Remi repository, dnf module enable php:remi-{v})
arch: sudo pacman -S php  (always the current release; older lines are in the AUR, e.g. php83)
alpine: sudo apk add php{nodot}  (e.g. php83; extensions are separate php{nodot}-* packages)
macos: brew install php@{v}  (or brew install php for the current release; brew link php@{v} --force to make it the default)
windows: scoop install php  (scoop bucket add versions; scoop install php{nodot} for another version)
or download the x64 Non Thread Safe zip from windows.php.net, unzip it, add the folder to PATH, and copy php.ini-development to php.ini

debian: sudo apt install composer  (or the installer from getcomposer.org for the latest release)
linux: Follow the installer instructions at getcomposer.org/download.

debian: Docker Engine from Docker's apt repository (docs.docker.com/engine/install), or on Ubuntu: sudo apt install docker.io docker-compose-v2
Add yourself to the docker group to run it without sudo: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER (log out and in)
fedora: sudo dnf install moby-engine docker-compose  (or Docker CE from docs.docker.com/engine/install/fedora)
arch: sudo pacman -S docker docker-compose && sudo systemctl enable --now docker.service
alpine: sudo apk add docker docker-cli-compose && sudo rc-update add docker && sudo service docker start
macos: brew install --cask docker  (Docker Desktop), or OrbStack / Colima

debian: sudo apt install git-lfs && git lfs install
fedora: sudo dnf install git-lfs && git lfs install
arch: sudo pacman -S git-lfs && git lfs install
alpine: sudo apk add git-lfs && git lfs install
macos: brew install git-lfs && git lfs install
windows: Git for Windows includes Git LFS; run: git lfs install
scoop install make  (or run the commands from the Makefile by hand)

debian: sudo apt install python3 python3-venv python3-pip

any: pipx install uv  (or the official installer from docs.astral.sh/uv)

debian: sudo apt install golang-go  (often older; for Go {v} use the tarball from go.dev/dl)

any: Install rustup from rustup.rs, then: rustup toolchain install {v}
arch: sudo pacman -S rustup && rustup default stable
macos: brew install rustup && rustup default stable

debian: sudo apt install ruby-full  (for a specific version use rbenv or mise)

any: Use the project's ./gradlew wrapper if it has one; otherwise sdk install gradle (SDKMAN)

debian: sudo apt install dotnet-sdk-{v}  (Ubuntu 22.04+; on Debian add Microsoft's package repository)
sudo apt install aspnetcore-runtime-{v}  (Ubuntu 22.04+; on Debian add Microsoft's package repository)
any: Install the .NET {major} SDK or ASP.NET Core runtime: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/{v}

fedora: sudo dnf install community-mysql-server && sudo systemctl enable --now mysqld
arch: sudo pacman -S mariadb && sudo mariadb-install-db --user=mysql --basedir=/usr --datadir=/var/lib/mysql && sudo systemctl enable --now mariadb
macos: brew install mysql && brew services start mysql
windows: winget install Oracle.MySQL  (or run it in Docker)
mysql.docker: docker run -d --name mysql -p 3306:3306 -e MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes -e MYSQL_DATABASE=app mysql:8

fedora: sudo dnf install postgresql-server && sudo postgresql-setup --initdb && sudo systemctl enable --now postgresql
arch: sudo pacman -S postgresql  (then initdb, see the Arch wiki)
macos: brew install postgresql@17 && brew services start postgresql@17
windows: The installer from postgresql.org/download/windows, or run it in Docker

fedora: sudo dnf install valkey  (Redis-compatible; or redis on older releases)
macos: brew install redis && brew services start redis
windows: Run it in Docker or WSL; there is no official Windows build
